controls.name: Database and Network Preflight Verification
controls.description: Verifies that PostgreSQL and Redis containers are healthy and connected to fg-local_default before any fixture activity.

controls.name: Direct Network Attachment Prior to Container Start
controls.description: Ensures the gateway container is attached to fg-local_default before boot using createDirectGateway helper.

controls.name: Strict Observer-Free Runtime Invocation
controls.description: Ensures that no preload script, startup wrapper, or ALS instrumentation is attached to the gateway process.

controls.name: Bounded Gateway Health Polling
controls.description: Validates that the private gateway becomes ready via HTTP 200 within bounded deadline without leaking database credentials in logs.
assertions: for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) polling /health with 1000ms timeout and 250ms interval
assert(ready, 'Private gateway failed to become ready; inspect sanitized diagnostics only')

controls.name: HTTP Endpoints, CSP Headers, and Asset Digests
controls.description: Verifies that the NestJS API, Vite preview server, security headers, and static assets meet exact build-2 specifications.

controls.name: Private Native WebRTC Signaling Isolation
controls.description: Guarantees that public port 7880 is never exposed on the host and signaling is strictly routed through private gateway port 7883.

controls.name: Retained Database Inspector Client Lifecycle
controls.description: Ensures that the dedicated inspector client connects, holds an identifiable backend PID, reports state, and cleanly releases without leaking pool clients or blocking queries.

controls.name: Three-Actor Recruitment, Room, and Membership State
controls.description: Inspects the state of the sender, receiver, and third actor to confirm room membership and conversation membership prior to browser session launch.

controls.name: Ephemeral Teardown and Direct Route Cleanup Verification
controls.description: Verifies that all test schemas, keys, containers, and networks are removed, while core PostgreSQL and Redis services remain intact.
assertions: assert(report.mediaRemoved, 'Media containers and network removal failed')
assert(report.appClosed && report.webClosed, 'Application or web server close failed')
assert(result.mainServicesUnchanged && result.existingNetworkUnchanged, 'Direct route cleanup verification incomplete')
